# Codex GA4 Portfolio Ops

> A portable Agent Skills-compatible workflow for GA4 measurement planning, property and stream administration, Web/App instrumentation, privacy review, API integrations, Computer Use QA, and reporting governance.

## Direct answers

- GA4 can measure websites, WebApps, Android apps, iOS apps, macOS apps, desktop WebViews, and secure server/offline outcomes using the appropriate Web, Firebase, or server-side collection surface.
- The baseline uses stable lower_snake_case events, separates CTA intent from confirmed outcomes, and validates Realtime, DebugView, duplicate tags, consent, and PII.
- The portable package is `SKILL.md`. Codex and Claude Code can use the Agent Skills layout directly; Cursor, TRAE, and other tools can use rules/context adapters; OpenClaw and CodeBuddy have their own skill directories.
- This repository is independent and not officially affiliated with Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Cursor, TRAE, OpenClaw, Hermes, CodeBuddy, or any model provider.
